subject: Initial tenant activation — first-mile workback & API key handoff
messages:
From: Michael Lin <mike.lin@arcadiahealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: rebecca.soto@arcadiahealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Arcadia initial tenant activation

Hi Sofia / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to start the tenant activation for Arcadia's pilot environment. High-level ask: can we get admin API keys and a seeded project with two environments (staging, prod) by next Thursday (Dec 3) so our engineering team can begin connectivity testing?

A couple clarifying items from our side:
- We'll need an admin API key pinned to the pilot workspace and a read-only key for monitoring (separate).
- Our security team needs a short evidence packet for key rotation policy and where logs are retained.
- Can you share a proposed workback of tasks and a single point of contact for technical handoffs?

I've attached our internal onboarding questionnaire and a short network diagram.

Thanks,
Michael
Director of Engineering — Arcadia Health
ops@arcadiahealth.com

Attachments: arcadia_onboard_packet.pdf (application/pdf, 412 KB)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Michael Lin <mike.lin@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Arcadia initial tenant activation

Hi Michael — welcome aboard.

Short answer: yes, we can get the staging project and API keys ready for connectivity testing by EOD Dec 3, pending the quick items below. I'll be your activation lead; Monica will run the implementation and Dev will handle the API-key provisioning and network checks.

Action items for Arcadia (quick answers will keep us on the Dec 3 target):
1) Confirm the admin and read-only user emails for the tenant seed (who should be in the Admin group).
2) Confirm whether you want key rotation enabled immediately or after pilot completion (we recommend rotation after pilot for fewer interruptions).
3) Confirm outbound IPs/firewall rules for our callback URLs (we can use the region us-west-2).

Internal plan (high level):
- Tue, Dec 1: Internal provisioning + seed projects created (Redwood).
- Wed, Dec 2: Key generation + permission mapping; deliver evidence packet for security.
- Thu, Dec 3: Arcadia connectivity test window (we'll be available 10:00–16:00 PT).

I'll attach a short guidance doc on our API key model and a preliminary workback spreadsheet.

Sofia Ivanova
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: redwood-api-key-guidance.md (text/markdown, 8 KB); activation-workback-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats, 24 KB)

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: Michael Lin <mike.lin@arcadiahealth.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Arcadia initial tenant activation — technical checklist

Hi Michael — looping in the minimal technical checklist so your engineers can parallelize while we provision: 

1) Authentication & keys
   - Admin key: scopes = admin:tenants,admin:keys,admin:projects
   - Read-only key: scopes = read:metrics,read:logs
   - Key TTL: we'll set to 90 days initially; rotate after pilot unless you request immediate rotation.

2) Projects & environments
   - We will create: arcadia-pilot-staging, arcadia-pilot-prod
   - Default model access: redwood/gpt-3.5-small; add additional models on request.

3) Network
   - Callback/webhook CIDR: 34.200.12.0/24 (us-west-2 egress range). Please confirm firewall rules.

4) RBAC seed
   - Seed Admin group: alice@arcadiahealth.com, mike.lin@arcadiahealth.com
   - Seed Observers: rebecca.soto@arcadiahealth.com

5) Evidence for security
   - We'll provide: key rotation policy excerpt, audit log sample, SOC2 questionnaire mapping.

Planned milestones (technical):
- Provisioning completed: Tue, Dec 1 by 18:00 PT
- Keys issued & shared via Vault link: Wed, Dec 2 by 12:00 PT
- Connectivity test and smoke validation: Thu, Dec 3 (10:00–16:00 PT)

Attachment: redwood-api-key-guidance.md (see guidance for how to use Vault links).

If you need earlier key handoff, let us know and we can expedite manual delivery (with MFA requirement).

— Dev Patel
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
